navigation.label: Exports
navigation.description: Download a list of this workspace as a CSV file.
page.title: Exports
page.description: Every export runs as a job: the list is read page by page under your own permissions, written as one CSV file, and kept for 30 days.
denied.title: Access denied
denied.hint: You do not have permission to read export jobs in this workspace.
start.title: Start an export
start.description: Pick a list and the job appears below while it runs.
start.loading: Loading the lists this workspace offers…
start.emptyHint: No enabled module offers a list you hold the permission to export.
start.deniedHint: You do not have permission to read the lists of this workspace.
table.title: Export jobs
table.caption: Export jobs in this workspace
table.emptyHint: Start an export from the list you want to download; it appears here while it runs.
error.catalogue: Could not load the lists this workspace offers.
error.open: Could not open that export file.
error.code.EXPORT_LIST_UNKNOWN: No module offers that list for export.
error.code.EXPORT_LIST_FORBIDDEN: You do not hold the permission this list requires.
error.code.EXPORT_JOB_NOT_FOUND: That export job does not exist in this workspace.
error.code.EXPORT_NOT_READY: That export has no file to open.
error.code.EXPORT_OBJECT_GONE: That export file is no longer stored.
error.code.EXPORT_ROWS_EXCEEDED: The list is longer than an export may hold; narrow it first.
error.code.EXPORT_BYTES_EXCEEDED: The file would be larger than an export may hold; narrow the list first.
error.code.EXPORT_LIST_FAILED: The list could not be read to the end.
error.code.EXPORT_LIST_STALLED: The list did not page to its end, so the export was stopped.
error.code.EXPORT_PAGE_OVERSIZE: The list answered more rows than an export page holds.
error.code.EXPORT_CELL_INVALID: A column answered a value a CSV file cannot carry.
error.code.EXPORT_CELL_TOO_LARGE: A column answered more text than a cell may hold.
error.code.EXPORT_STORAGE_FAILED: The file could not be stored.
error.code.EXPORT_DEFINITION_INVALID: That list export is declared incorrectly.
error.code.EXPORT_LIST_DUPLICATE: That list export is already registered.
error.code.EXPORT_LIST_INVALID: That list export declaration is not accepted.
error.code.EXPORT_LISTS_SEALED: List exports are registered while the platform starts.
error.code.REQUESTER_TOO_LARGE: Your account carries more grants than an export job can record.
error.code.JOB_FAILED: The export stopped on an unexpected failure.
settings.maxRows.label: Rows per export
settings.maxRows.description: Rows one export may hold; a longer list fails instead.
settings.maxBytes.label: Bytes per export
settings.maxBytes.description: Bytes one export may hold; the storage object limit still applies.
